Class ReactiveBootstrapContextAdapter

java.lang.Object
org.hibernate.reactive.boot.spi.ReactiveBootstrapContextAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
BootstrapContext
public class ReactiveBootstrapContextAdapter extends Object implements BootstrapContext
